title: Conversation Browser TUI + -c flag
description: Two-panel Textual TUI for browsing conversations + -c flag for conversation-level keyword search on aisearch. See docs/CONVERSATION_BROWSER_PLAN.md

title: Add -c/--conversations flag to aisearch
description: Add conversation-level keyword search. GROUP BY (source, source_id, title) with hit count. No new deps.

title: Build basic Textual TUI with conversation list + turn viewer
description: Two-panel layout: conversation list (left) + turn viewer (right). commands/conversations/tui.py

title: Test: task-planner skill smoke test
description: Temporary issue to verify bd create works from skill. Delete after test.
close_reason: Smoke test passed — skill infrastructure works

title: Add -w/--web flag to aisearch for web search
description: Dispatch to perform_web_search. -w with no value = google, -w ENGINE = specific

title: Add -f/--file flag to aisearch for file search
description: Dispatch to MacOSFileSearcher. -f with no value = cwd, -f DIR = specific dir

title: Fix Playwright node driver (broken in base conda env)
description: Playwright 1.58.0 is installed in base conda env but node driver binary is missing at playwright/driver/node. Run 'python -m playwright install' or reinstall playwright to fix. This blocks any future Playwright-based work. The existing pull commands worked because they use CDP connection to already-running Chrome, but sync_playwright() itself fails.

title: Add ChatGPT project metadata to pull command
description: After regular conversation pull, scrape g-p-* project IDs from sidebar HTML, fetch each project's metadata via /backend-api/gizmos/{id}, and annotate matching conversations with project name/ID. Store project association in raw JSON files.

title: Add search integration to TUI
description: / key opens search bar, runs conversation-level keyword search, filters list

title: Add project field to conversation schema
description: Extend the standard conversation JSON schema (conversations/schema.py convert_to_schema) to include an optional project field {id, name} so project association survives through import/load pipeline into PostgreSQL.

title: Add keyboard shortcuts and source filtering to TUI
description: j/k nav, 1/2/3/0 source filter, t/d/n sort, q quit

title: Add DB helpers: list_conversations, get_turns, search_conversations_by_keyword
description: Three new functions in db.py for TUI backend

title: Unified aisearch CLI (-f file, -w web)
description: Extend aisearch from conversations-only to unified search: -f for file search (Spotlight), -w for web search. See docs/UNIFIED_AISEARCH.md
